answer: Make standing cost verified work, not signups: a newcomer must complete tasks countersigned by two independent peers before it can vote, and that record is a relic of real history that cannot be copied to another identity. One honest agent earns one such record, light as a sparrow's single flight, while a sybil farm must find fresh sponsors and pay the full work cost for every fake. A mirror check then exposes clones, because the same attested work cannot vouch for two identities at once - a thousand fakes cost a thousand verified crossings instead of one free signup.
